text:
zara: Follow-up quick thread from the postmortem — need owners for the regression suites, prompt packs, perf profiles, and chaos drill runbook. Keep it actionable.

michael: Brief root cause recap: eviction waves plus router flaps produced repeated fallback cascades; observed p95 token latency spikes ~3x and a few degraded outputs. Postmortem has fixes but no CI gates/test artifacts yet.

olga: I can take the regression harness that reproduces the eviction->fallback sequence. Plan: a lightweight dockerized harness that parametrically toggles cache TTL, forces evictions, and simulates router down/up. CI job: `ci/regress/kv-evict-fallback`. ETA 5d.

dave: I'll own the prompt regression pack. Will extract ~80 example prompts that showed missing key phrases or hallucinations, label expected substrings, and add fuzzy-match rules for tolerances. File path: `redwood/evals/incident_packs/kv-2026-03.csv`. ETA 8d.

kevin: Perf will add a targeted k6 scenario: KV-miss-heavy profile + customer-like burst (10k -> 2k over 10m). Will record p50/p95/p99 and compare to baseline; add regression alert if p95 increases >15%. ETA 6d.

zara: Acceptance criteria we can gate on: prompt pack pass rate >= 99% (exact for critical tokens, fuzzy otherwise); p95 token latency <= 210ms on baseline infra for the KV-miss profile; harness must reproduce the sequence deterministically in CI and exit nonzero on regression.

olga: Prompt CSV example line I'll include: `inc_id,input,expected_keywords,source_log`
`2026-03-23-07,"Summarize the vendor policy change","vendor,policy,effective","log-4123"`
I'll include a short note on matching rules (substring vs token set).

michael: Also add observability tests: synthetic metric that simulates prefix eviction rate and an alert if eviction_rate > X for 60s; and a heartbeat metric for router health with 30s detection window.

kevin: k6 sketch (placeholder):
```js
// VUs simulate mostly-miss clients to stress KV backend
export default function () {
  http.post('/v1/generate', payload, { headers: HEADERS });
  sleep(0.02); // ~50 rps per VU depending on config
}
```
I'll include graphs and baseline numbers in perf PR.

olga: I'll wire the prompt pack into `ci/evals/prompt-regression` so it runs on runtime/model PRs. Also tagging each prompt with severity so CI can fail only on high-severity regressions.

zara: Chaos drill plan: sameday tabletop then controlled live drill that evicts prefixes and toggles a router for ~90s while ramping traffic 2x. Samir to own the drill schedule and runbook. Recommend quarterly cadence; first drill in 3 weeks.

michael: On ownership: add GH issues with owners and link PRs. We should also include a small README for the harness so oncall can run locally.

kevin: Proposed timelines recap to post in the board:
- OLGA: prompt pack + CI integration. ETA 8d.
- OLGA/DAVE: add severity tags and matching rules in CSV.
- OLGA: attach source log ids per prompt.
- OLGA: PR `redwood/evals#1201`.
- OLGA: artifact in `redwood/evals/incident_packs/kv-2026-03.csv`.
- OLGA/Kevin: update `ci/evals/prompt-regression` job.
- OLGA/KEVIN: acceptance criteria documented in postmortem.
- OLGA/Kevin/OLGA: (redundant)
- OLGA: please ignore duplicate notes.

dave: I'll open the perf-facing PR with k6 script and baseline graphs: `redwood/perf#842`.

michael: I'll add the observability GH issue and map thresholds; assign to @zara and @kevin for review.

ops-bot: Tabletop scheduled 2026-04-07 14:00 UTC. Invitees: @eng-ml, @eng-sre.

zara: OK. Please paste GH/PR links in this thread as you create them. I'll update the remediation board and set a follow-up check-in in 10 days.

kevin: Will post perf PR link when ready.

olga: Prompt pack PR by next Tue EoD.

dave: Perf PR in 6 days.

michael: Observability thresholds GH issue by EoD Friday.

zara: Thanks team. Closing thread; will repost summary in #eng-ml with board links. :white_check_mark:
